status_policy: The status field is derived by build() from the gates below; check() recomputes and compares. Missing status is fail-closed (not ready). T27_READY is bound by full verification acceptance and is never hand-written.

stages.T27a: Opening snapshot is bound to the T26 READY report and T26.5 current publication 19087/16862/2225.
stages.T27b: Seven T13 tables reclassified: canonical 765, unclassified 0, T13 in_scope does not auto-upgrade to v1_required.
stages.T27c: Open-item ledger and A-E tracks are current: orphan 0, tracks not started, F003/F005 remain T27 RC contracts.
stages.T27d: Portfolio aggregate is a pure derived view of the seven tables and open items.
stages.T27e: T28+ topology is recomputed from unclosed v1_required identities; no RC number; cards are not started and implement no content.

closure_policy.reason: T27 freezes the v1.0 portfolio. Publication delta remains 0/0/0. Unclosed v1_required identities generate T28+ topology only. T27 does not implement crucible, O-36, or any 1.x content. F003/F005 stay on the T27 RC candidate contract.
